n8n told the AI Writer that two outlets covering the same story are NOT duplicates ("include both"), so one story appeared two or three times, often in different sections. Now one story = one bullet in its best-fit section naming every outlet (and carrying every item id, see ID_RULE).

The ledger allowed only 4 reasons while FILLER REJECTION requires reason "filler" (the model already emitted it). Added filler as the 5th valid reason.
Items from official bodies carry "official": true; when an agency and the press cover the same story, the agency's own word leads.
